content.title: Portland Trail Blazers vs. Denver Nuggets: How to watch streaming live, game preview, odds
content.text: Portland Trail BlazersDenver Nuggets guard and Christian Braun (0) will host Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers on Sunday at Ball Arena.AP Photo/Ali GradischerBy Joe Freeman | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe Portland Trail Blazers play the Denver Nuggets on Sunday in an NBA matchup at Ball Arena.Here are the details:PORTLAND TRAIL BLAZERS (35-36) vs. DENVER NUGGETS (43-28)When: 3 p.m., Sunday, March 22Where: Ball Arena, DenverRadio: Rip City Radio (KPOJ 620 AM).TV channel: KUNP (Antenna: 47.1. Xfinity: 16, 302, 1170. DirecTV: 47. Spectrum: 184). NBATV.Online: Seventy-six of the Blazers’ 82 games this season can be streamed live or on-demand via BlazerVision for an annual fee of $120. For more information about Rip City TV and how to watch Blazers games, visit nba.com/blazers/watchTrail Blazers vs Spurs NBA Playoffs tickets are on sale now — Here’s where fans can get the best deals Trail Blazers vs. Spurs: Western Conference playoff scheduleThe most improbable Blazers season got its most improbable endingDeni Avdija was already an All-Star. Play-in win was his superstar moment| Bill OramTrail Blazers rally to stun Suns in NBA play-in tournament, clinch playoff berthODDS (Oregon Lottery/DraftKings)Moneyline: DEN -240 POR +270Spread: DEN -8.5 | Over/Under: 237.5This and that: The Blazers have won three consecutive games and five of the last seven, surging to eighth place in the Western Conference standings. They enter Sunday’s NBA slate tied with the Los Angeles Clippers, two games ahead of the slumping 10th-place Golden State Warriors. . ... Four of the five recent Portland wins have come against a collection of the worst teams in the NBA (the Indiana Pacers, Brooklyn Nets and Utah Jazz), but the Blazers defeated the Minnesota Timberwolves 108-104 on Friday night in Minneapolis, earning their first victory against an opponent with a winning record since Feb. 22. ... Jerami Grant scored Portland’s final eight points in the win, hitting a pair of clutch threes and two free throws in the final 1:40 to spark the win. ... Donovan Clingan recorded 21 points, 12 rebounds, four assists and three blocks against the Timberwolves, continuing a two-game stretch of dominance that has seen him average 24.5 points, 12.5 rebounds, 3.0 assists and 2.5 blocks. ... This is the finale of a five-game trip for the Blazers, who are 17-20 on the road this season. ... Portland has 11 games left in the regular season. ... This is the third and final meeting this season between the Blazers and Nuggets, who have split the first two games. In the last outing, the Nuggets demolished the Blazers 157-103 at the Moda Center, producing the points in a regulation game and the second-most in a half (82) in franchise history. ... The Nuggets have won four of their last six games, which includes a 121-115 victory over the Toronto Raptors on Friday night in Denver. ... Jamal Murray finished with 31 points and six assists and Nikola Jokic added 22 points, nine rebounds and eight assists in the win. ... Denver leads the NBA in scoring, averaging 120.7 points per game, and three-point shooting percentage (39.2). INJURIESPortland: Jerami Grant (left foot soreness) and Vit Krejci (left calf bruise) are questionable, and Shaedon Sharpe (left calf strain/fibula injury) and Damian Lillard (left Achilles tendon) are out.Denver: Peyton Watson (right hamsring strain) is questionable.NEXT UPThe Blazers play the Brooklyn Nets on Monday at 7 p.m. at Moda Center.Joe Freeman is a senior writer at The Oregonian/OregonLive, who covers the Portland Trail Blazers and the NBA.
